summary: Qualitative verification of ultrafixer at 6ca101b completed without re-running mechanical checks. Schema v8, ledger CRUD, defect CLI, packet template, and coordination doc satisfy the Go/SQL/CLI MUSTs and the zero-new-dispatch-plumbing decision; remaining gaps are agent-instruction completeness (worktree CLI refusal, missing declined-disposition path, thin packet protocol vs spec MUSTs) rather than missing persistence machinery.

hard_stops.hard_stop: Executing mechanical test/build commands when mechanical results are already provided.
Any credential value would need to be chosen, generated, or written.
A done-criterion turns out to be impossible, or already true for a reason the packet did not anticipate.
Two reasonable interpretations exist for a spec requirement and the specification does not say which.
Satisfying one instruction in this packet would require violating another.

RecordDefect/GetDefect/ListDefects (internal/ledger/ledger.go:1464-1572) are called by runDefectRecord/runDefectList (cmd/lucind-ai/cli.go:1932,1979), which are routed from run() case "defect" (cli.go:153-154). ultrafixer-packet-template.md is parsed by packet.Parse in TestUltrafixerPacketTemplateContract (internal/packet/packet_test.go:2045-2056) and named as the Orchestrator dispatch asset in dependencies-defects.md:7 via lucind-ai run --packet (cli.go:153-154 run switch plus existing run path). idx_defect_records_feature is asserted by TestSchemaV8ConstraintsAndIndexes (schema_test.go:507).

findings.finding: Schema v8, CHECK constraint, and reopen idempotency match defect-records spec. schemaVersion=8; migrateV7ToV8DDL creates STRICT defect_records with the specified columns, disposition CHECK IN ('recorded','repaired','declined','deferred'), and idx_defect_records_feature(feature_id, id). migrate() applies the step only when currentVersion < 8. Tests open a real v7 fixture, assert preserved runs/lanes/events/approvals/progress, reject invalid_disp via CHECK, and prove reopen does not duplicate version 8 or drop the inserted row.
findings.affects: Requirement: Ledger schema v8 persistence for defect records

findings.finding: Ledger API matches the spec and design contract and is exercised on real rows. RecordDefect inserts (not upserts) a row; GetDefect returns ErrDefectNotFound on miss; ListDefects filters by feature_id and orders by created_at ASC, returning an empty slice rather than nil. Tests round-trip ID/feature/run/lane/signature/evidence/disposition/timestamps through SQLite, reject an invalid disposition string through RecordDefect, and assert chronological ordering plus cross-feature isolation.
findings.affects: Requirement: Defect record query and retrieval API; Scenario: Defect record stores complete error signature and evidence

findings.finding: CLI defect record/list satisfy the CLI spec with real stdout and a real ledger read-back. Routing, required-flag rejection (--id/--feature/--signature; list --feature), unknown-action errors, confirmation line, and list output containing ID, signature, and disposition are all tested via in-process run() against a temp git repo. Missing: no CLI test for invalid --disposition (relies on SQLite CHECK), duplicate --id, or empty-list stdout.
findings.affects: Requirement: CLI defect inspection commands; Evaluation area: CLI flag validation

findings.finding: Zero new production Go under internal/run/, internal/executor/, or internal/packet/ on the apply commits. git diff dcd6ac4^..6ca101b -- internal/run internal/executor internal/packet lists only internal/packet/packet_test.go and internal/packet/testdata/skill_content_hash.txt. That matches design.md's 'Zero new Go dispatch plumbing' decision. Plugin version-guard files (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json, plugin/claude-code/.claude-plugin/plugin.json) were also bumped because the skill asset/docs changed; those are outside the design File Changes table but are consumed by the plugin version/hash tests.
findings.evidence: git diff --name-only dcd6ac4^..6ca101b -- internal/run internal/executor internal/packet; openspec/changes/ultrafixer/design.md:18-23,267-276
findings.affects: Design fidelity: Zero new Go dispatch plumbing

findings.finding: Ultrafixer running in its isolated linked worktree cannot call the CLI verbs the protocol tells it to use. resolvePrimaryRoot is git rev-parse --show-toplevel (the linked worktree path). runDefectRecord, runDefectList, and runFeatureStatus all refuse when IsLinkedWorktree(primaryRoot) is true. The packet template requires lucind-ai feature status for two-axis evaluation, and dependencies-defects.md:19 tells ultrafixer to persist via lucind-ai defect record. An agy lane at ../<repo>-worktrees/<id> will get 'refusing to run from inside a linked worktree'. Non-critical persistence via Ledger.RecordDefect is therefore unreachable from the dispatched agent unless it cds to the primary repo — which the packet does not instruct.
findings.affects: Requirement: Non-critical non-blocking defect persistence; Requirement: Independent two-axis evaluation and multi-branch triage

findings.finding: No disposition state machine exists beyond insert-time CHECK. RecordDefect's comment says 'inserts or replaces' but the SQL is a plain INSERT (duplicate id hits PRIMARY KEY). There is no UpdateDefect, no transition recorded→repaired/declined/deferred, and no wiring from operator decline of a blocked ultrafixer envelope to disposition=declined. Spec scenario 'Human declines fix' MUST record declined in the ledger; neither the CLI, serve handlers, nor dependencies-defects.md implement or instruct that write. serve.Model is named as a terminal consumer in design.md:44 and tasks.md 1.4/1.6 but internal/serve has no RecordDefect/ListDefects/GetDefect calls (existing 'defect' routes mark approvals.defect_surfaced_later only).
findings.affects: Requirement: Isolated repair delivery — Scenario: Human declines fix; Design: serve.Model consumer; Evaluation area: disposition state machine

findings.finding: Packet template and coordination doc cover origin classification, two-axis eval, signal reproduction, isolated worktree, blocked envelope, and human-gated integrate retry at instruction level (correct for zero new dispatch Go). Gaps vs ultrafixer-dispatch MUSTs that the agy agent actually executes: (1) template is labeled 'Tier: B (auto-merge after audit)' while the spec MUST NOT auto-integrate — Tier is body prose not parsed by packet.Packet, so it does not mechanically merge, but it contradicts the hard stop on the same page; (2) template never mentions conventional commit formatting or forbidding Co-Authored-By (spec MUST at ultrafixer-dispatch/spec.md:55); (3) multi-branch encoding is only 'questions and findings' — it does not require distinct per-branch Question.WhyBlocking/Options/Recommendation or Finding.Affects; (4) TestUltrafixerPacketTemplateContract only asserts packet.Parse frontmatter plus section heading strings, not those protocol MUSTs, despite tasks.md threat-matrix claiming 3.1 asserts failing-command scope, isolated worktree, and zero AI attribution.
findings.affects: Requirements: Origin classification; Signal reproduction; Isolated repair delivery; Multi-branch blocked disposition encoding; Test quality

findings.finding: CLI does not validate --disposition against the four allowed values before RecordDefect. Empty disposition is defaulted to recorded (cli.go:1897-1900), but an explicit invalid string is forwarded as DefectDisposition(disp) and fails only at SQLite CHECK. That meets the spec's 'database CHECK MUST reject' scenario; it is a flag-validation hole the evaluation area called out, and there is no TestDefectRecordCLIInvalidDisposition asserting stderr.
findings.affects: Evaluation area: CLI flag validation for lucind-ai defect record

findings.finding: dependencies-defects.md was rewritten from a manual assessment contract to ultrafixer packet dispatch via lucind-ai run --packet, blocked-envelope handling via lucind-ai integrate retry, and feature-local regressions staying in the feature lane. That matches the MODIFIED spec. Context placeholders for the failing command and error transcript exist in the packet template (lines 48-52).
findings.affects: Requirement: Structured ultrafixer defect triage coordination
